payload.why_worse_than_clean_fail: Skill maps claimed:false -> backoff (transient contention), NOT the C-2 fail-closed branch (which keys off error/db_unavailable). So if wired live + serialization lifted, EVERY commit returns claimed:false forever -> ~125s backoff -> give-up -> skip -> BUG telegram per cycle. Fleet-wide permanent commit freeze. Fail-safe direction, but non-functional mutex.

2. Add 'commit-mutex' to both zod enums in coordinationTools.ts (lines 82 & 188) — else tool-boundary rejects before SQL.
3. docker compose up -d --build mcp-server + run Deployment-verified Ritual (task-lock-protocol.md L139-152): verify Up<minutes>+healthy, call live tools, record outputs.
4. Harden skill: claimed:false WITH no current_holder => treat as mechanism-broken => fail-CLOSED skip + distinct BUG msg, NOT 6 contention retries.
5. Re-run singleton-deny + stale-reclaim smoke test with real tool outputs; re-signal PO for lift decision.
